product_metadata.title: XONOR Artificial Flowers Plant - Potted Fake Daisy, Faux Mixed Color Daisies in Wooden Vase for Home Party Wedding Office Desktop Decoration (Set of 2)
features: Super valuable set, package come with set of 2 potted full artificial daisy flowers. Each set include 25 branch daisy flowers, 7 branch eucalyptus plant, 1 white wooden tray, 1 white PE foam and 10 ladybugs.
The silk daisy flowers are brightly colored, look very pretty. Mixed greenery plastic eucalyptus make potted flowers more realistic, elegant.
Artificial flowers will never fade and don't need water, fertilizer or tending. We can put them in any indoor place as we want, but no hassle or worries with upkeep.

Our lovely artificial flowers are so charming and beautiful, absolutly a perfect addition to your entry hall, home, hotels, office, guest houses, kitchen, windowsill, living room, dining table, bedroom, book shelves, fire place mantel or any other indoor place where you want to decor with flowers.

The artificial flowers are self assembling, the flowers & ladybugs & wooden tray packed separately in the carton box. But it is very easy to assemble and you will get much fun together with your family or friends. Do it yourself now, you will make your life more colorful, beautiful & unique.
